null_policy: preserve absence using the explicitly chosen destination representation; zero remains a value

mapped.price: convert the toy exponent -2 to integer scale 1e4 with checked multiplication
mapped.side: map known values explicitly; reject unknown values
mapped.stopPrice: preserve the null versus zero distinction
mapped.symbol: resolve through the destination reference data

legacy_reader: reject the hypothetical new message type unless explicitly supported
archive_policy: retain raw framed bytes and an appropriate old decoder; route by declared type/schema/template/version
deployment: upgrade readers before writers; log behavior changes for replay
dedup: separate frame retry from request dedup; reject conflicting bytes
